updates.sentence: Initial pretrial detention at King County Jail from April 4 to April 5, 1968, when William Dwyer obtained release on bail. Sentenced July 1, 1968 to six months for unlawful assembly arising from the Franklin High School sit-in; conviction later overturned and not retried. The displayed April custody interval does not represent the imposed six-month sentence; any subsequent custody after sentencing remains unverified.

entries.rationale: UW project confirms April 4 detention at bond hearing; HistoryLink dates release the next day, April 5, and separately July 1 sentencing. Record the verified initial detention only; do not extend it across intervening bail to the later sentence.
